# openmetadata_pipeline_service (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata Pipeline Service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_pipeline_service" "example" {
  name         = "MyPipelineService"
  display_name = "My Pipeline Service"
  description  = "Managed by Terraform."
  service_type = "Airflow"

  connection_json = jsonencode({
    config = {
      type = "Airflow"
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name identifying the resource.
- `service_type` (String) Type of pipeline service (e.g. Airflow, GlueAirflow, DatabricksPipeline, Nifi, SparkPipeline).

### Optional

- `connection_json` (String, Sensitive) Pipeline connection configuration as a JSON string. Sensitive and not read back from the API.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the resource.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the domains this resource belongs to.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the resource.
- `id` (String) UUID of the resource assigned by OpenMetadata.

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Required:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner entity (user or team).
